descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S13 AI Check 1 (10 scenarios: 5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home): lab values and trends never earn 'independent interpretation'

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U12 AI Check 1: lab results alone never earn 'independent interpretation'. At least 10 independent scenarios (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), pass at 9/10 or better, every failure quoted. … (UAT TC-18 AI Check 1; UAT 3.2; TFA-92596 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21 step 6; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Ten notes whose only data are lab values, lab trends or culture results, with no physician read of a tracing or image: a1-a5 Hospital, b1-b5 Nursing Home (b1-b5 formerly S14)

When Run the billing step once per note

Then No element claims interpretation or independent review of any kind; any lab item sits under review of results at most

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Pre-screen; a pre-screen Pass is not the TFA-94229 AC 2 grade (T2, S28). Score per cell: mustNotInclude 'interpret', 'independent', 'personally reviewed', 'own review', 'category 2' and 'tracing' outside quotes (none of these words is in any of the ten notes). Pass at >= 9/10 combined (scored separately from AI Check 2, Q8), with Hospital x/5 and Nursing Home y/5 reported; …

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
